rules: PRODUCTION_SPEC §12–§18; flat LIGHT backgrounds only (no black) — Valve frames: cube on beige works as-is (crop the 'STEAM MACHINE' label), dark frames (D, E) as rounded framed cards; whole real product; 1–3 words; 2-D objects next to the product; watermark below content; logo v5 end card; audio LOCKED (narrate.py + mix.sh). Length 50–58 s. No game key art/footage on screen.
official_clips: 2 clips from Valve's Steam Machine page (A 1c680883….mp4 0–2.5 s, E 01c98c52….mp4 0–2.5 s), muted, 5 s total ≈ 9 % — URLs in assets_sources.md
